concept: Modeling healthy boundaries for children or those you mentor, rather than just enforcing rules on them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic parenting or mentoring scenario where the adult's own boundary-setting behavior is being watched and absorbed by someone younger
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does your own behavior around boundaries teach, regardless of what you say?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one place where their modeled behavior and their stated advice don't currently match

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies a real, specific gap between what they model and what they preach
